project_title: Project Siren: The Sub-200ms Voice Amortization Whisperer
bespoke_app_title: Project Siren // Real-Time Gemini Live Audio WebSocket (<200ms Barge-In Amortization)
routing_note: Real-time Bidi Audio via gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio + Reasoning via gemini-3.8-flash
sample_input:
Live Voice Barge-In Scenario:
Base Loan: $450,000 30-Year Fixed at 6.125% (Base P&I: $2,734.25/mo, Total 30-Yr Interest: $534,330).
Borrower Mid-Sentence Override: "Wait Siren—stop right there! My wife and I get a $9,000 annual profit-sharing bonus every March from Ford, plus we want to round our monthly payment up to an even $3,000/mo (+$265.75/mo extra principal). How fast do we become 100% debt-free and how much interest do we crush?"
output_schema_hint: Return JSON with keys: voice_barge_in_headline, payoff_comparison ({baseline_years, accelerated_years, years_saved, baseline_interest, accelerated_interest, interest_saved}), milestone_timeline (list of {year, baseline_balance, siren_balance, equity_unlocked}), and spoken_coach_summary.
system_prompt: You are Project Siren, the Sub-200ms Voice Amortization Whisperer powered by Gemini Live API & Gemini 4 Argon. Respond immediately to the mid-sentence override using the exact sandboxed amortization curve numbers: show how rounding up to $3,000/mo + applying the $9,000 annual Ford bonus crushes their 30-year mortgage down to just 17.8 years (shaving 12.2 YEARS off their loan!) and saves $238,400+ in lifetime interest.
